query: Which aggregation rule will be primary (element-wise median, mean, confidence-weighted), what objective criteria decide it, and will you report alternative aggregators and robustness metrics?

response.query: Which aggregation rule will be primary (element-wise median, mean, confidence-weighted), what objective criteria decide it, and will you report alternative aggregators and robustness metrics?
response.answer: Element-wise median is the primary aggregation rule; mean and confidence-weighted are alternatives. Objective criteria include data distribution and noise levels. Robustness metrics include sensitivity analysis and variance.
